readings.hub: The Lab is a playtest hub: cards can be an enemy, a weapon, a combo or a map, so new weapons and maps join it later as more cards.
readings.length: tl-length (until Done) and the notes (5-15 minutes, a long or short option) agree once there is a Quick (2 waves) / Full (8 waves, about 10 minutes) switch; Done ends a test early either way.
readings.pace: Lab waves are their own: a fast, even pace from the first wave (the wave 5 table, not a map's ramp), rotating scenarios (swarms, missiles, aircraft, platforms) so the card meets various situations; normal upgrades between waves.
